name: All Hours Communications
summary: Far-north QLD call-centre group (Anthony Dodds); took over GetOnIt / Cairns Net / AussieWide effective 27 Mar 2008, amalgamated under the AussieWide banner; site live to 2024, ABN cancelled 2026.

events.details: Cairns-based call-centre operator (Anthony Dodds). Founding predates the archive; earliest Wayback capture 7 Dec 1998.
ABN cancelled 11 Mar 2026; allhours.com.au live with retail content through 2024 (prior 'c. 2016' death year contradicted the archive and has been corrected).
